legal.not_configured: To be completed by the operator

legal.revision_note: These notices describe the application code and the deployment facts supplied by its operator. The operator must review them whenever services or data flows change.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.body: The person or organisation running this instance determines how account and health data are used. Contact them to exercise privacy rights or ask about this deployment.
controller.name: Controller

data.title: Data the service handles
data.body: Apex stores account and profile details, activity and wearable measurements, sleep and recovery data, food and training records, laboratory results and uploaded documents when you provide or connect them. It also stores chat messages, AI outputs, source metadata, security sessions and operational logs. Connected providers and features determine which categories are actually present. Health data can reveal sensitive information.

purposes.title: Purposes and legal grounds
purposes.body: The app uses data to provide your account, import connected records, display trends, generate requested analyses and recommendations, secure access, and maintain backups. Its code does not establish a legal ground by itself; the operator must determine and explain the applicable GDPR Article 6 ground and separate Article 9 condition for health data before collecting it. A consent choice is required if the operator relies on explicit consent for health data.
purposes.account_basis: Ground for account and service processing:

recipients.title: Services and transfers
recipients.body: Optional connections may exchange data with Garmin, WHOOP, Oura, Strava, COROS, Technogym, Fitbit and Open-Meteo. Connected providers have their own privacy terms. Depending on configuration, AI prompts and selected context can go to an external chat model, text can go to OpenAI for embeddings, and voice notes can go to OpenAI for transcription. The operator may use encrypted offsite backups on Backblaze B2. The operator must confirm each enabled service, contract, location and any transfer outside the EEA before use.
recipients.telegram: Optional owner operational notifications send feedback, invite redemption and sanitized system events to Telegram. Feedback submissions include the author, page, time and message; avoid medical details and secrets. The owner must disclose this recipient and verify its applicable processing and transfer terms.

retention.title: Storage and deletion
retention.body: The scheduled cleanup removes processed raw imports after 180 days, qualifying activity streams after 400 days, and selected AI/tool/sync logs after 400 days. Expired sessions are purged. Other account and derived records remain until the operator or user deletes them or another retention rule applies. These windows depend on scheduled jobs actually running.
retention.preferences: In Data Health, you can set retention periods for laboratory observations and agent tool logs. You can download a selected-records account JSON export (at most 100,000 rows per table) and observations CSV; these are not a complete copy of every record. You can also preview and erase a connected source; that operation removes linked data and cached analyses, but is not full account deletion. Reconnecting a source may import data again.
retention.backups: Encrypted database backups may contain earlier copies after live deletion. The default schedule retains up to 14 daily and 6 monthly local archives; automatic-update recovery backups are kept separately until the operator removes them. Any offsite copies require separate operator verification and expiry handling.

rights.title: Your choices and rights
rights.body: You may ask the controller for access, correction, erasure, restriction, portability, or objection where the GDPR provides those rights. If processing relies on consent, you may withdraw it without affecting earlier lawful processing. Requests can require identity verification and legal exceptions may apply. Use the privacy contact above for requests, including whole-account erasure.
rights.controls: Available self-service export and source-erasure controls are in
rights.authority: You may lodge a complaint with the Italian Garante per la protezione dei dati personali or your local EEA supervisory authority.

automated.title: AI-assisted outputs
automated.body: The app generates scores, summaries and suggestions from incomplete or estimated data. You decide whether to follow them. The code does not make a solely automated decision with legal or similarly significant effect. If the operator changes the service to do so, this notice and safeguards must be reviewed.

service.title: Service scope
service.body: Apex Health is a private, self-hosted, invite-based wellness and training service. The operator controls invitations and enabled features. These terms apply to use of this instance; separate connected-provider terms may also apply.

access.title: Accounts
access.body: Keep your login details secure and use only accounts and connected devices you are authorised to access. You can disconnect providers and request account closure through the operator. Access may be paused to protect the service or other users.

health.title: Health information
health.body: Scores and AI responses are informational estimates for wellness and training. They can be wrong or incomplete and do not diagnose, treat or replace a qualified professional. In an emergency, contact local emergency services. Do not use the service as the sole basis for medical decisions.

providers.title: External services
providers.body: Imports and AI features depend on services selected by you or the operator. A provider can change access, data quality or availability. Review each provider's own terms before connecting it.

responsibilities.title: Content and use
responsibilities.body: Enter data you have the right to share. Review imports and generated plans before acting on them. Do not use the service to access another person's records or interfere with its security. The operator must provide contact and any additional consumer terms required for the actual deployment.

changes.title: Changes and contact
changes.body: The operator should date and communicate material changes to these terms before they take effect. Contact the operator using the address in the privacy notice about access or these terms.

cookies_used.title: Essential cookies
cookies_used.body: After sign-in, Apex sets hcc_session for your session and csrf_token to protect actions against cross-site request forgery. The session cookie is HttpOnly; the CSRF cookie is readable by the app so it can send the matching security header. Both are SameSite=Lax and normally Secure on HTTPS. The session lifetime defaults to 12 hours with a 30-day absolute cap. These cookies are needed for signed-in access. Without Remember me, these are browser-session cookies. With Remember me, both persist for a fixed 30 days; sign-out revokes the session immediately.

local_storage.title: Storage in your browser
local_storage.body: The app stores language and display preferences, recent sync-job state, and an unsent coach chat draft and selected conversation in localStorage on this device. Account-specific values are cleared on sign-out or session change. An unsent draft may contain sensitive text until then; clear this site's browser data on a shared device after an abrupt close. The app code does not install advertising or analytics cookies. Hosting or added third-party scripts must be checked separately.

cookies_choices.title: Managing storage
cookies_choices.body: You can clear this site's cookies and local storage in your browser. Clearing essential cookies signs you out; clearing local storage removes device-only preferences and drafts. If the operator adds optional tracking, it must provide separate information and a valid choice before enabling it.

metricEducation.influences_note: These are possible influences in general, not factors Apex has identified as causes today.

resting_hr.definition: Resting heart rate is the number of heartbeats per minute while you are at rest.
resting_hr.why: Your own recent pattern is usually more useful for tracking change than a comparison with another person.

hrv_ms.definition: Heart rate variability (HRV) describes variation in the time between consecutive heartbeats.
hrv_ms.why: Repeated readings can show how your measurements vary over time; one value does not identify a cause or readiness.

respiration.definition: This is the recorded average breathing rate, in breaths per minute, for the associated measurement or sleep session.

spo2.definition: This is a sensor reading of estimated blood oxygen saturation, shown as a percentage.

sleep_duration.definition: Sleep duration is the device-recorded estimate of time asleep during a sleep session. It can differ from time in bed.

weight.definition: Weight is the body-mass value recorded by the connected source.

body_fat.definition: Body fat percentage is an estimate supplied by a device or service. Its measurement method depends on that source.

vo2max.definition: VO₂ max is an estimate of the maximum rate of oxygen use during exercise, supplied by a device or service.

steps.definition: Steps are the count recorded by the connected source for the measurement period.

floors.definition: Floors are the count recorded by the connected source. Devices can use different rules for counting elevation gain.

hydration.definition: Hydration is the fluid amount recorded in the connected source. It is not a direct measurement of body hydration.

provider_sleep_score.definition: This sleep score is calculated by the data source using its own model. The formula and scale interpretation are not standardized across sources.

sleep_deep.definition: This is the device’s estimated time classified as deep sleep. Sleep-stage labels are inferred from sensor data.

sleep_rem.definition: This is the device’s estimated time classified as REM sleep. Sleep-stage labels are inferred from sensor data.

sleep_light.definition: This is the device’s estimated time classified as light or core sleep. Sleep-stage labels are inferred from sensor data.

restlessness.definition: This is a source-reported estimate of movement or restlessness during sleep. Its scale and method depend on the source.

acute_load.definition: Acute load is the sum of the selected activity-load values in the most recent 7-day window.

chronic_load.definition: Chronic load is the sum of selected activity-load values in the most recent 28-day window, divided by four to express a weekly average.

acwr.definition: ACWR compares recent acute load with the longer-term chronic load using the same selected load scale. It is a descriptive ratio, not a target.

recovery.definition: Recovery is an Apex estimate produced by a fixed heuristic blend of available signals. It is not a direct measurement of recovery.

readiness.definition: Readiness is an Apex estimate that blends available recovery, sleep-architecture and workload-balance components.

strain.definition: Strain is an Apex estimate that expresses a day’s activity load relative to a rolling personal load peak.

sleep_score.definition: This Apex sleep-architecture estimate blends available sleep-stage proportions and sleep efficiency.

hrv_deviation.definition: HRV deviation is the percentage difference between the day’s HRV and the average of recorded HRV readings in the preceding baseline window.

systemic_stress.definition: A heuristic blend of HRV, resting heart rate, respiration and reported fatigue signals. It is not an illness probability.

load_spike.definition: A descriptive heuristic of recent load relative to personal load history. It does not predict injury.

factors.measurement_context: Measurement timing, device fit, wear time and source-specific processing
factors.sleep_timing: Sleep timing and how the device identifies the sleep session
factors.load_method: Which compatible activity-load method and records are available
factors.hormonal_context: Hormonal context, including a menstrual cycle where applicable, can influence HRV and resting heart rate. This is a possible influence, not an inferred cause.

actions.resting_hr: Sleep consistency, appropriate training recovery and regular hydration are factors you can influence. This value alone does not identify a cause or justify trying to lower your heart rate.
actions.hrv_ms: Keep measurement conditions consistent and consider the broader context. HRV varies naturally; there is no need to maximize a single reading.
actions.consistent_measurement: Use the source as directed and compare readings taken in similar conditions. A single reading does not establish a cause.
actions.sleep_duration: A regular sleep opportunity and consistent recording can make duration trends easier to interpret; the device estimate is not a measure of sleep quality.

methods.observed_range: Apex compares the latest value with comparable observations from the preceding 28 days, excluding the assessed day. The personal band is P10–P90; the baseline comparison uses the median. At least 14 comparable observations are needed.
methods.recorded_value: The value is shown as recorded by the connected source; Apex does not calculate a direction or recommendation from it.
methods.sleep_session_estimate: The source estimates a sleep session and its total time asleep from its available signals. Apex displays the recorded duration.
methods.provider_estimate: The source supplies this estimate. Apex does not have the exact calculation details for this record and does not reconstruct the source formula.
methods.load_aggregation: Apex selects one best-covered load method for the window and sums its available daily values. Missing or incompatible sessions may be excluded; different load scales are not treated as equivalent or converted to a common TSS scale.
methods.acwr_ratio: ACWR = 7-day load sum / (28-day load sum / 4). Both windows use the same selected load scale; this ratio is descriptive and does not establish a safe or optimal range.
methods.edwards_trimp: Time in heart-rate zones weighted by intensity. The current method uses age-estimated maximum heart rate; an individually measured maximum is not recorded by this calculation.
methods.garmin_recorded: Garmin recorded load uses the provider’s own load values. This scale remains separate from Edwards TRIMP and other providers’ scales.
methods.recovery_blend: Heuristic blend of available physiological deviations, Apex sleep architecture and prior-day strain. Recorded calculation details are shown only when preserved.
methods.readiness_blend: Heuristic blend of available Apex recovery, sleep architecture and recent load context. Recorded calculation details are shown only when preserved.
methods.strain_peak: Apex compares the day’s selected activity load with the rolling 28-day peak load, using a minimum ceiling so a short or quiet history does not automatically produce a maximal score.
methods.sleep_architecture: Apex blends available REM proportion, deep-sleep proportion and sleep efficiency using configured weights. The components are estimates based on recorded sleep data.
methods.hrv_deviation: Apex compares the day’s HRV with the mean of recorded readings in the preceding 28 days. At least seven prior readings are required; the assessed day is excluded.

limits.measured: The observed band describes your recorded history, not clinical thresholds. Device, source and measurement context can affect comparability.
limits.recorded: A recorded value can be incomplete or source-specific. Counts and logged amounts do not establish health status or a recommended target.
limits.sleep_estimate: Sleep duration is a device estimate and may differ from actual sleep or time in bed. It does not identify sleep quality or a cause of change.
limits.provider_estimate: This is a source estimate, not a direct measurement. Methods and interpretation can differ by source and may change over time; the source may be unknown in this view.
limits.load_aggregate: Load units depend on the selected method. Provider load and Edwards TRIMP are not interchangeable; missing or incompatible activities can be excluded. This aggregate is not necessarily TSS.
limits.acwr_not_target: ACWR is not a validated personal safety threshold or a prescription. A ratio alone cannot predict injury or determine appropriate training.
limits.composite_inputs_unavailable: This is a heuristic estimate, not a clinical measure. The actual inputs and weights for this date are not preserved, so this explanation cannot identify what drove the score.
limits.estimate_not_clinical: Treat this as a descriptive estimate, not a medical diagnosis or a calibrated probability of a health condition.
limits.measured_baseline_deviation: This derived comparison depends on available readings and baseline coverage. It is not a clinical threshold or a diagnosis.
limits.sex_calibration: This heuristic has no validated sex-specific or pregnancy-specific calibration. It does not estimate cycle phase or correct for an unrecorded menstrual cycle.

registry.legacy: The exact historical calculation was not stored.
registry.snapshotUnavailable: Exact calculation record unavailable for this assessed value.

completion.load_missing: Training load needs recorded load or sufficient heart-rate data. Check Data health and complete your profile if inputs are missing.

physiology.lab_ranges_note: Copy the intervals on your own laboratory report in the same units as the result. They may depend on sex, age and pregnancy. Leaving them blank does not assume a male or female normal range.
physiology.profile_note: Used for your body outline and physiological context. Sex alone does not establish menstrual phase, pregnancy or hormone status.

athlete.progressive_note: A few useful details, at your pace. Every step can be completed later, and no health details are required.
athlete.question_0: Which training priorities matter most now?
athlete.question_1: What is your main goal or next important event?
athlete.question_2: How much time is realistically available each week?
athlete.question_3: Which days and times are usually available?
athlete.question_4: Do you already follow a training plan?
athlete.focus_note: Choose none, one, two or all three, then order them. All other sports stay in your activity log and calendar.
athlete.main_goal: Main goal or next important event (optional)
athlete.availability_note: These are local times in your account timezone. An empty schedule means unknown availability, not unlimited time.
athlete.complete_window: Complete the time window or remove it before saving.
athlete.upload_existing_plan: Review an existing plan in Documents
athlete.optional_details: Optional details — add them when useful
athlete.schedule_constraints: Travel, shift work or variable schedule
athlete.rpe_preference: Would you like to record session effort?
athlete.ftp_note: Enter a value you already know and its measurement date. Apex does not estimate FTP; cycling calculations require confirmation and a value no older than 90 days at the activity date.
athlete.ftp_confirm: I confirm this dated FTP value.
athlete.restrictions_note: Non-medical planning context. You never need to share injuries or health details to complete this profile.
athlete.open_context: Tell Apex anything else that may help it understand your training, goals, schedule, preferences, or constraints.
athlete.context_privacy: Optional and editable. You can export or delete this context. It is sent to external AI only with active consent and server authorization.
athlete.conflict: This record changed. Reload and review the current version before saving.
athlete.save_error: Could not save. Check the fields and try again.
athlete.ai_disclosure: With your voluntary consent, Apex may send your selected training context, approved plan documents and relevant eligible data to the configured external AI provider for coaching summaries and reviewable proposals. AI output is informational: it does not diagnose, provide medical advice or automatically change training.
athlete.ai_withdrawal_note: You can withdraw consent at any time to stop new AI processing immediately. Historical records may remain for the documented audit and retention period. The operator's privacy notice describes the provider, processing location, retention, and deletion and export rights.
athlete.ai_agreement: I agree to the use of my selected training and health-related context by Apex's configured AI provider for personalized coaching summaries and reviewable training proposals.
athlete.consent_withdrawn: Consent withdrawn. Future AI processing is blocked.
athlete.budget_exhausted: Your daily AI budget is exhausted. New provider calls are blocked.
athlete.budget_reset: Budgets reset at 00:00 UTC. Calls reserve allowance before they start; a request may need more than the remaining allowance.
athlete.day_before_training: Your planned training, together in one place.
athlete.day_activity_recorded: An activity is recorded. Review what happened and what remains planned.
athlete.day_multiple_sessions: Your recorded sessions and remaining plans form one daily timeline.
athlete.day_no_plan: There is no confirmed plan or activity for this day.
athlete.legacy_gym_context: Existing gym plan. Review it in Training; it is not automatically associated with an activity.
athlete.association_explanation: Suggestions match the local day, sport and duration within 20%. They never mark a planned session complete without your confirmation.
athlete.duration_comparison: Planned {{planned}} min · recorded {{recorded}} min · difference {{delta}} min
athlete.no_prescription: Add context or review an existing plan when useful. Apex will not invent a workout from missing information.
athlete.load_scales_note: Totals include only compatible recorded units. Garmin load, WHOOP Strain and Apex TSS-style remain separate.
athlete.checkin_limits: Self-reported planning context, not a medical assessment. A check-in does not change your plan automatically.
athlete.life_events_note: Record constraints without re-entering your profile. These inputs may support a reviewable adaptation; they never apply a change automatically.
athlete.metrics_limits: Descriptive calculations from recorded evidence. Unknown inputs stay unavailable; these are not medical assessments or performance predictions.
athlete.review_document_first: Review and confirm this document before using it as planning context.
athlete.plan_document_note: An upload is not an active plan. Review a structured draft, confirm actual dates and workouts, and approve it explicitly. Unclear items remain visible.
athlete.use_active_plan: Use this as my active plan
athlete.ai_optional_extraction: AI extraction is optional. Manage consent in Profile.
athlete.add_workout: Add a workout from the document
athlete.confirm_structure_agreement: I have reviewed these workouts and uncertainties. Use this exact structure as my active planning baseline.
athlete.structure_error: Could not save or activate. Check actual dates, sports, workouts and reviewed uncertainties. Nothing was activated.
athlete.reason_missing_duration_or_distance: Recorded distance and a positive duration are required.
athlete.reason_missing_reliable_moving_time: Reliable recorded moving time is unavailable.
athlete.reason_missing_elevation_or_duration: Recorded ascent and a positive duration are required.
athlete.reason_insufficient_valid_splits_or_cove: At least three valid splits and sufficient distance coverage are required.
athlete.reason_missing_hr_speed_or_continuity: Valid, sufficiently continuous HR and speed streams are required.
athlete.reason_requires_30min_continuous_valid_h: At least 30 minutes of continuous moving HR and speed evidence are required.
athlete.reason_missing_recorded_or_configured_zo: Provider or explicitly configured zone information is missing.
athlete.reason_missing_voluntary_rpe_or_duration: Record a voluntary RPE check-in to calculate this separate load.
athlete.reason_missing_power_or_reliable_moving_: Recorded power and reliable moving time are required.
athlete.reason_requires_dense_continuous_power_s: Dense continuous power samples are required; gaps are not simulated.
athlete.reason_missing_confirmed_ftp: An explicitly confirmed and dated FTP is required.
athlete.reason_ftp_after_activity: This FTP was measured after the activity and cannot describe it.
athlete.reason_stale_ftp: The confirmed FTP is older than 90 days at this activity date.
athlete.reason_missing_normalized_power: Valid calculated Normalized Power is required.
athlete.reason_missing_normalized_power_or_durat: Valid Normalized Power and recorded duration are required.
athlete.reason_missing_compatible_np_average_pow: NP and average power must come from the same valid stream.
athlete.reason_requires_30min_continuous_valid_p: At least 30 minutes of continuous power and HR evidence are required.
athlete.reason_input_limit_exceeded: This recording exceeds the bounded calculation input limit.
athlete.limit_recorded_duration_semantics: Pace uses the duration recorded by the source; pause conventions may differ.
athlete.limit_terrain_and_session_context: Compare only similar sports, terrain and session context.
athlete.limit_provider_moving_time_definition: Moving time retains the provider's explicit recording convention.
athlete.limit_cadence_convention_provider_specif: Cadence conventions depend on the source; no stride-to-step conversion is inferred.
athlete.limit_ascent_rate_over_full_session: Ascent is averaged over the full recorded session, not just climbs.
athlete.limit_altitude_recording_quality: Altitude recording quality affects ascent values.
athlete.limit_split_lengths_may_differ: Different split lengths and terrain can change variation.
athlete.limit_at_least_3_splits_of_200m: Requires at least three valid splits of 200 metres or longer.
athlete.limit_80_to_110_percent_distance_coverag: Valid splits must cover 80–110% of the recorded distance.
athlete.limit_descriptive_not_threshold: Descriptive ratio; no physiological threshold is inferred.
athlete.limit_90_percent_valid_hr_speed_coverage: Requires at least 90% valid HR and speed coverage.
athlete.limit_sample_gaps_at_most_5s: Only recorded intervals no more than five seconds apart are used.
athlete.limit_terrain_temperature_and_intensity_: Terrain, heat and changes in effort can affect the result.
athlete.limit_30min_continuous_moving_effort: Requires a continuous moving segment of at least 30 minutes.
athlete.limit_pauses_excluded: Paused intervals are excluded; missing samples are not invented.
athlete.limit_provider_zone_definitions_required: Uses recorded zone definitions only; no thresholds are inferred.
athlete.limit_subjective_self_report: RPE is the athlete's voluntary self-report.
athlete.limit_separate_load_scale: Keep this unit separate from provider load and other load scales.
athlete.limit_mechanical_work_not_metabolic_calo: Mechanical work is not an estimate of metabolic calories.
athlete.limit_provider_power_averaging_conventio: Summary average-power conventions can depend on the source.
athlete.limit_apex_calculation_not_provider_valu: An Apex calculation, distinct from a recorded provider metric.
athlete.limit_descriptive_not_prediction: Descriptive metric, not a performance prediction.
athlete.limit_1Hz_recorded_power: Requires recorded power at one-second intervals.
athlete.limit_95_percent_power_coverage: Requires at least 95% valid power coverage.
athlete.limit_5min_continuous_segment: Requires a continuous power segment of at least five minutes.
athlete.limit_30s_windows_without_gap_interpolat: Uses 30-second rolling windows within continuous recordings; no gap interpolation.
athlete.limit_explicit_ftp_not_estimated: FTP must be provided and confirmed explicitly; it is not estimated.
athlete.limit_ftp_90_day_max_age: FTP must be no older than 90 days at the activity date.
athlete.limit_descriptive_not_threshold_predicti: No threshold or performance prediction is made.
athlete.limit_same_recorded_stream_only: Both values use the same recorded power stream.
athlete.limit_90_percent_power_hr_coverage: Requires at least 90% valid power and HR coverage.
athlete.objective_uncertain: Plan objective: uncertain. Review whether this alternative still supports your goal.
athlete.objective_deferred: Plan objective: deferred by this rest alternative.
athlete.adaptation_gaps: Data gap: no supporting observations attached. No physiological outcome is predicted.
athlete.adaptation_evidence: Review the cited evidence and unknown session context before approval.
athlete.zones_note: Optional explicit bounds, used only from their effective date when recorded provider zones are absent. Lower bounds are included; upper bounds are excluded. No thresholds are inferred.
athlete.limit_explicit_zone_bounds_not_inferred: Uses your explicit zone bounds; thresholds are not estimated.
athlete.limit_uncovered_values_not_assigned: Recorded values outside configured bounds remain unassigned.
athlete.limit_90_percent_zone_stream_coverage: Requires at least 90% valid zone-stream coverage.
athlete.formula_cadence: Recorded provider cadence, or time-weighted mean of valid recorded cadence samples
athlete.formula_split_consistency: Population SD of split pace / mean split pace × 100
athlete.formula_aerobic_efficiency: Time-weighted mean speed / time-weighted mean heart rate
athlete.formula_cardiac_drift: ((HR/speed) second moving half / (HR/speed) first moving half − 1) × 100
athlete.formula_hr_zone_time: Provider-recorded durations, or recorded sample seconds within your explicit heart-rate zone bounds
athlete.formula_power_zone_time: Provider-recorded durations, or recorded sample seconds within your explicit power zone bounds
athlete.formula_normalized_power: Fourth root of mean fourth powers of valid 30-second rolling mean power
athlete.formula_intensity_factor: Apex Normalized Power / explicitly confirmed FTP
athlete.formula_variability_index: Apex Normalized Power / average power from the same recorded stream
athlete.formula_power_hr_decoupling: ((HR/power) second moving half / (HR/power) first moving half − 1) × 100
athlete.advanced_optional_note: Sport history, equipment and measured zones are optional. Add them when they help your training.
athlete.availability_bulk: Add a time to several days
athlete.availability_apply_first: Apply this time to your schedule or cancel the entry before saving.
athlete.availability_choose_days: Choose at least one day for this time.
athlete.availability_overnight: End time must be after start time on the same day. Overnight windows are not supported; enter separate daytime windows.
athlete.availability_overlap: Times on the same day cannot overlap. Edit or remove the existing time first.
athlete.availability_limit: You can save up to 28 time windows. Remove a window before adding more.
athlete.availability_applied: Time added to your schedule. Save your athlete context to keep it.
athlete.availability_exceptions: Edit an individual day below to make an exception. Add another time above when needed.
athlete.unsaved_changes: You have unsaved changes to your athlete context.
athlete.profile_saved: Athlete context saved. Your active training plan has not changed.
athlete.profile_save_scope: Saving updates your athlete context. It does not activate or change a training plan.
athlete.leave_unsaved: You have unsaved athlete context. Leave and discard these changes?
athlete.context_no_profile: Tell Apex what you train to get started.
athlete.context_profile_incomplete: Your athlete profile is saved. Add any details that would help you plan.
athlete.context_profile_ready: Your athlete profile is ready. You do not have an active training plan yet.
athlete.context_plan_draft: Your training plan draft is ready to review. It has not been activated.
athlete.context_template_ready: Your weekly schedule is saved. Choose dates and review the workouts before activating a plan.
athlete.context_active_rest_day: You have an active plan. No workout is scheduled for this day.
athlete.availability_already_added: This time is already in your schedule. No duplicate was added.
athlete.profile_deleted: Athlete context deleted. Your active training plan has not changed.
athlete.context_historical_empty: No planned or recorded session on this date.
athlete.journal_assertion_help: Your feedback is a self-reported observation, not a diagnosis or a completion inferred from a matching date.
athlete.allocation_help: These are your preferences, not automatically prescribed workouts. Your total allocation must fit your weekly time budget.
athlete.allocation_exceeds_budget: Your allocation exceeds the weekly time budget. Adjust either before saving.
athlete.season_priority_order: Choose disciplines in priority order for this period.
athlete.season_invalid: Each season needs increasing dates and at least one discipline. Seasonal periods cannot overlap.

athleteImport.title: Import Athlete Information
athleteImport.intro: Upload TXT, Markdown or PDF, or paste your text. Review your background, goals and weekly schedule before saving. Your active plan changes only after you preview dated workouts and activate them.
athleteImport.source_text: Read or paste the text to analyze
athleteImport.source_scope: Analyze confirms this text as a source for this import only. Uploaded sources are not Coach instructions or approved athlete facts.
athleteImport.pdf_paste: This PDF has no readable text. Copy or transcribe the relevant text below, then analyze.
athleteImport.source_required: Choose a text file or paste text before analyzing.
athleteImport.source_too_long: Use at most 16,000 characters. Split the document into shorter imports.
athleteImport.read_error: Could not read the file. Paste the text instead.
athleteImport.ai_assistance: Use my authorized AI access to suggest facts for review (optional)
athleteImport.manual_available: Manual review is available without AI. Analyze identifies subjects; add the facts you want to save using the fields below.
athleteImport.analyzed: Source reviewed. A proposal is ready; your profile and active plan have not changed.
athleteImport.review_note: Correct the fields inline and choose which facts to save. Unchecked fields stay unapproved. Unknown details can remain blank.
athleteImport.included: Included when you save to your profile.
athleteImport.discarded: Not selected. This fact will not change your profile.
athleteImport.required_question: Required: correct the fields above before using your correction.
athleteImport.optional_question: Optional: correct this now, or leave this fact or workout out for later.
athleteImport.profile_scope: Only your selected athlete facts will be saved. This does not activate a training plan.
athleteImport.saved_profile: Athlete profile saved. Your active plan has not changed.
athleteImport.saved_review: Review saved. You can return later; no plan has been activated.
athleteImport.saved_template: Weekly template saved. Choose dates when you want to create a plan.
athleteImport.saved_dated: Dated plan preview is ready. Review every workout before activating.
athleteImport.required_profile_note: Answer the required questions beside selected facts, or unselect those facts to continue.
athleteImport.enter_selected_fields: Enter a value for each selected fact, or unselect it.
athleteImport.profile_unavailable: Your athlete profile could not be loaded. Reload before saving.
athleteImport.review_missing: Open an import to review first.
athleteImport.plan_optional_note: Planning is optional. You can finish after saving your profile, save a weekly template without dates, or review an explicitly dated plan.
athleteImport.weekly_note: These rows repeat on weekdays. Blank duration, distance and targets remain unknown; no calendar dates are assumed.
athleteImport.targets_note: Enter only targets explicitly stated in the source or chosen by you. Leave missing values blank.
athleteImport.template_scope: Saved templates are not active plans. Choose dates and preview the full calendar before activation.
athleteImport.explicit_dates_note: Choose the exact first and last calendar date. Apex repeats the reviewed weekday rows only within this range (up to 367 days).
athleteImport.preview_note: {{count}} workouts. Review all dates and targets below before activation.
athleteImport.complete_dates: Complete dates, sport and required decisions before activating.
athleteImport.activation_scope: Activating will replace your active plan with exactly these reviewed workouts.
athleteImport.plan_activated: Training plan activated. These workouts are now on your calendar.
athleteImport.source_receipt: Saved source only. Athlete facts are not approved yet.
athleteImport.review_receipt: Review saved. Facts still need explicit profile or plan confirmation.
athleteImport.profile_receipt: Selected athlete facts confirmed in your profile. Plan activation is separate.
athleteImport.load_error: Could not load your saved information. Reload this page to try again.
athleteImport.conflict: The source or profile changed while you were reviewing. Your edits are still here. Reopen the latest saved review or reload the page before confirming.
athleteImport.general_documents: Advanced: general documents and earlier plan reviews
athleteImport.general_documents_note: These documents use the earlier source confirmation workflow and may be available to Coach after confirmation. Use Import Athlete Information above for personal facts and weekly templates.
athleteImport.legacy_question_note: Correct the workout fields, then mark this question resolved and save the revised draft. Optional unknown targets may stay blank.

structuredWorkout.title: Workout details
structuredWorkout.scope: Edit blocks and explicit targets, review the complete sequence, then confirm. A draft does not change the planned session.
structuredWorkout.repeat_note: Each repetition follows the child blocks below in order, including recovery. Nested repeat groups are not supported.
structuredWorkout.add_child: Add a block to this repeat
structuredWorkout.invalid_block: Complete a valid target range, repetition count or positive duration/distance. A repeat needs at least one valid child block.
structuredWorkout.target_note: Leave unknown stop conditions and targets unspecified. Choose only recorded or explicitly intended targets; no physiological zones are inferred.
structuredWorkout.review_scope: Draft ready. Confirming will replace the session instructions with exactly the sequence shown above.
structuredWorkout.read_scope: These are the saved instructions for this planned session.
structuredWorkout.saved: Workout confirmed and saved. Your calendar now uses these instructions.
structuredWorkout.load_error: Could not load this owned planned workout.
structuredWorkout.save_error: Could not save the workout. Your review is still here; check the block values and try again.
structuredWorkout.conflict: The plan or workout changed, or this session is protected or historical. Your review is still here. Reload the current workout before proposing new changes.
structuredWorkout.blocked_past: This past session is a historical record and cannot be rewritten.
structuredWorkout.blocked_protected: This session or its plan is protected. Remove protection explicitly in plan management before editing.
structuredWorkout.blocked_completed_or_skipped: Completed and skipped sessions remain historical records.
structuredWorkout.blocked_recorded: This session has a recorded activity. Its prescription remains a historical record.
structuredWorkout.blocked_history: This workout is available for review only.
structuredWorkout.no_structure: This session has no approved structured blocks. Its existing description is preserved until you explicitly confirm new instructions.
structuredWorkout.education_note: These deterministic instructions are available without AI. Follow only explicit targets and adapt conservatively to your condition.
structuredWorkout.conservative_note: Avoid starting too hard, skipping prescribed recovery, or inventing missing zones. Reduce effort or shorten the session when recovery is poor; stop for concerning symptoms. Any plan change still needs your explicit review.
structuredWorkout.view_calendar: View this date on the calendar
structuredWorkout.export: Export approved workout as portable JSON
structuredWorkout.export_note: Exports contain approved instructions only. Device delivery has not been requested and device compatibility is not verified.
structuredWorkout.duration_review: Recorded total block duration: {{seconds}} seconds. Confirming a fully timed sequence also updates the planned duration to its rounded-up minutes. Unknown block duration preserves the current planned duration.

sportProgress.subtitle: Recorded history, source quality and transparent performance comparisons.
sportProgress.range_error: Choose increasing dates covering at most 730 days.
sportProgress.timezone: Calendar dates use your account timezone: {{timezone}}.
sportProgress.supported_sports: This overview supports running and cycling.
sportProgress.load_error: Could not load sport history. Try the date range again.
sportProgress.missing_note: Missing measurements remain unavailable. A missing recording is not proof that you did not train.
sportProgress.empty: No activities were recorded for this sport in the selected range.
sportProgress.partial: Some history or streams exceeded the analysis limit. Available results are partial; check the source details.
sportProgress.coverage: Distance observed in {{distance}}/{{count}} activities; duration in {{duration}}/{{count}}.
sportProgress.no_chart_data: No eligible measurements for this chart. Missing values are not plotted as zero.
sportProgress.trends_note: Saved goals are context, not inferred prescriptions. Comparisons require compatible recordings and conditions.
sportProgress.review_goals: Review sport goals and event targets
sportProgress.long_run_note: Each eligible run is compared with the longest eligible run in the preceding 30 elapsed days. Check both distances and the observation window. This is descriptive, with no universal safe percentage or individual injury prediction.
sportProgress.power_mode: Eligible dense power recordings support the curve below. Best power in this range is not a validated FTP test.
sportProgress.partial_power_mode: Power was recorded, but eligible dense windows are missing for some analyses. Heart-rate and activity history remain usable.
sportProgress.hr_mode: Heart-rate and activity mode: power analysis is optional. Missing power does not prevent reviewing your cycling history.
sportProgress.power_points: Review each power point and its source
sportProgress.best_efforts_note: Provider, distance and moving/elapsed conventions stay separate. Recorded efforts are not independently verified tests.
sportProgress.advanced_note: Estimates and efficiency proxies are labelled. Unsupported models and missing sources remain unavailable.
sportProgress.unavailable: Eligible recordings or a supported method are missing. Open source details for the exact reason.

reasons.invalid_current_distance_or_source_quali: Current distance or recording quality is not eligible.
reasons.no_eligible_dense_power_window: No complete eligible dense-power window for this duration.
reasons.requires_dense_power_and_full_duration_w: This duration needs a complete dense power window.
reasons.insufficient_comparable_easy_steady_reco: Not enough comparable easy or steady recordings with suitable HR, stream and environment data.
reasons.no_confirmed_due_sessions: No confirmed sessions due in this range.
reasons.no_explicit_measurable_progress_target: No explicit measurable goal target has been confirmed.

reasons.unsupported_model_no_validated_grade_adj: No validated grade-adjustment method is available for these recordings.

reasons.data_missing_compatible_30min_steady_eff: No compatible 30-minute steady effort is available.
reasons.incomplete_history: Loaded history is incomplete; this comparison is unavailable.
reasons.empty_date_range: No eligible recordings in this date range.

sharing.fields: Fields included in the shared snapshot
sharing.feedback_optin: Include only the session feedback fields I select below
sharing.review: Review exactly what will be shared

sharing.revoke_error: Could not revoke the link. Try again.

equipment.missing_distance: Distance is unavailable for {{count}} linked activities.
equipment.link_activity: Add an activity to this equipment
equipment.reminder_help: Choose your own intervals. These reminders are not a universal lifespan estimate. Leave both empty to remove reminders.
equipment.save_error: Could not save equipment changes. Retry.
equipment.defaults_help: Applies only to new imported activities. Existing history changes only through an explicit association.
equipment.set_default: Set as default for this sport

activityComparison.title: Comparison context
activityComparison.description: Add your own route and session context to compare similar easy or steady efforts. These are athlete assertions; saving does not guarantee an eligible comparison.
activityComparison.route_help: Reuse exactly the same route identity only for the same route and direction. Choose the convention supported by this recording; moving time must be recorded explicitly.
activityComparison.weather_missing: Outdoor comparisons still need recorded session temperature, humidity and wind. Daily weather summaries and this annotation do not supply those measurements.
activityComparison.recorded_context: Imported comparison context is preserved and takes precedence when eligible. Your annotation remains labelled as an athlete assertion.
activityComparison.remove_review: Remove your comparison assertion for this source. Imported measurements and context remain preserved.
activityComparison.provenance: This context is self-reported and is not provider verification of the route or effort.
activityComparison.acknowledge: I reviewed the route, terrain, setting, time convention and effort intent for this session.
activityComparison.conflict: The context changed since you opened it. Reload and review the current context before saving.
activityComparison.error: Context could not be saved. Check the fields and try again.
activityComparison.no_provider: This activity has no supported linked recording source for a comparison annotation.
activityComparison.eligibility: Comparisons require the same source, discipline, route, terrain, setting, time convention and effort intent, plus adequate continuous speed and heart-rate recordings. Outdoor weather must be compatible.
activityComparison.climbs: Climb comparisons require imported verified segment identity, measured ascent and distance in metres, elapsed duration in seconds, and recorded segment weather. This form does not create or verify climb measurements.
